subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: ERP Systems
description: A micro-lesson that makes ERP Systems usable.

hook.text: A factory's purchasing team orders parts that the warehouse already has. Without ERP, nobody knew.

buildup.text: ERP—Enterprise Resource Planning—connects every department into one system: inventory, orders, finance.

discovery.text: It gives everyone a single version of the truth. No more spreadsheets that don't match.

twist.text: ERP implementations are expensive and painful. Over 50% of projects exceed budget or timeline.

climax.text: SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft dominate the market. Almost every large company now runs on ERP.

punchline.text: One system, one truth. That's what ERP promises.
